name: Elg
author: hundekraft
description: Elg is Norwegian for moose. Three saws per voice (the root, a detuned root and a third saw at an interval above) go through a growl drive and a resonant low-pass filter. A slow LFO moves the filter and the level, a little random drift moves the pitch, and every voice moves on its own, so chords breathe and drift apart. On the screen, a moose's head sits under the northern lights.
